summary: Barfresh Food Group filed a 424B5 prospectus to register 5,550,602 shares for resale by selling stockholders, comprising conversion shares (at $2.50/assumed price) and warrant shares ($3.20 exercise price). No new primary offering; proceeds to issuer only from warrant exercises (~$7.5M potential). The filing is a routine shelf-takedown resale registration for existing notes and warrants, not a special situation event like an acquisition or restructuring. The shares represent ~25.6% of outstanding stock, creating potential overhang but no corporate transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond standard terms. This is an ordinary forward sale registration with no unusual features warranting a special-situations classification.
